name: Aeva Technologies, Inc.
summary:
Aeva Technologies (AEVA) reported a loss of $0.47 per share on revenue of $6.26 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.43 per share on revenue of $4.67 million. The Earnings Whisper number was a loss of $0.41 per share. The company missed expectations by 14.63% while revenue grew 85.93% on a year-over-year basis.

Founded in 2017 by former Apple engineers Soroush Salehian and Mina Rezk, and led by a multidisciplinary team of engineers and operators experienced in the field of sensing and perception, Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception technology to broad applications from automated driving to consumer electronics, consumer health, industrial robotics and security.
subject: Aeva Technologies Missed Expectations
